name: clearframe
description: Autonomous rights clearance and chain-of-title investigation for film and television.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @clearframe/shared && npm run build -w @clearframe/api && npm run build -w @clearframe/web
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @clearframe/api & npm run dev:worker -w @clearframe/api & npm run dev -w @clearframe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @clearframe/shared && npm run typecheck -w @clearframe/api && npm run typecheck -w @clearframe/web
